name: history-bounded-blob-batches
goal: Bound Git blob batch memory while preserving committed reads.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A large history source index gathers thousands of Git blobs into an unbounded response and overlapping reads can launch another response concurrently.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing populated read case covers large single blobs, missing objects and retry, but not many simultaneous blobs or overlapping batches. Extend that same case with real Git fixtures and bounded response checks.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed case 264233787b observed two simultaneous Git payload batches; record eb92dc67dbd4.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Commit 4528125944 serializes Git payload batches and bounds their count and declared bytes.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged case passed at 4528125944; paired red 4df7fbbb1aff and green 07d36ac218bf.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
